1. URI Structure and Resource Naming Conventions
Apex RESTful endpoints represent resources using plural, lowercase nouns. URIs must never contain actions or verbs:
Correct: GET /api/v1/documents (List documents)
Correct: POST /api/v1/documents (Create document)
Correct: GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/chunks (List chunks belonging to document)
Forbidden: POST /api/v1/getDocument or POST /api/v1/save-doc

3. Standard Error Envelope Schema
All 4xx and 5xx API error responses must adhere strictly to the standardized enterprise JSON envelope:
{
  "status": "error",
  "error": {
    "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    "message": "The submitted payload failed schema validation.",
    "details": [
      {
        "field": "query",
        "issue": "Field is required and cannot be null."
      }
    ]
  },
  "timestamp": "2026-10-17T08:00:00Z",
  "request_id": "req-98f2b34a-91dc-4a11"
}

4. Pagination, Versioning, and Rate Limiting
Cursor-Based Pagination: Standard for real-time querying: /api/v1/query?limit=20&cursor=cD0yMDI2 .
Returns next and previous cursor links.
API Versioning: Explicit URI path versioning (e.g., /v1/ , /v2/ ). Deprecated versions are maintained for 12
months with Deprecation and Sunset HTTP headers.
Throttling: Enforce rate limiting returning standard headers: X-RateLimit-Limit: 1000 , X-RateLimit-
Remaining: 842 , X-RateLimit-Reset: 1776412800 . Excess requests return 429 Too Many Requests .
